candidates.change_summary: Replace the owner check with require(false) so that no call to sendTo ever succeeds, changing the observable behavior (transfer never occurs).
Delete the require statement so that anyone can call sendTo and transfer ether, changing access control behavior.
Replace msg.sender with address(0) in the require condition so the owner check always fails, preventing any transfer.
Replace the entire transfer call with a no-op (empty statement) so ether is never sent.
Replace the transfer amount with a constant 0 so the owner can call but no ether moves.
